title_en: Malaysia Aviation Group orders 10 Boeing 787s to replace its Airbus A350 fleet
title_zh: 马来西亚航空集团订购 10 架波音 787 飞机以取代其空客 A350 机队
summary: Malaysia Aviation Group (MAG) has ordered 10 Boeing 787 Dreamliners directly from Boeing, with options for six more,… The post Malaysia Aviation Group orders 10 Boeing 787s to replace its Airbus A350 fleet appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 马来西亚航空集团 (MAG) 已直接从波音公司订购 10 架波音 787 梦想飞机，并可选择另外购买 6 架……马来西亚航空集团
body_en: Malaysia Aviation Group (MAG) has ordered 10 Boeing 787 Dreamliners directly from Boeing, with options for six more, as it prepares to renew its long-haul fleet.
Announced on November 25, 2026, the aircraft will be powered by GE Aerospace GEnx-1B engines and are scheduled for delivery between 2032 and 2035. Financial terms were not disclosed.

The agreement was signed at a ceremony in Kuala Lumpur attended by Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim. Once the aircraft arrive, Malaysia Airlines will become the first Malaysian airline to operate the 787.

“The acquisition of the 787 Dreamliner represents a strategic investment in the future of Malaysia Aviation Group,” said Captain Nasaruddin A. Bakar, President and Group CEO of MAG. He said the aircraft would strengthen the group’s ability to serve key international markets “with greater capacity, efficiency and flexibility.”
The 787s will gradually replace Malaysia Airlines’ seven Airbus A350s, which MAG plans to phase out over the same period, between 2032 and 2035.

The new aircraft will be fitted with 319 seats in a three-class configuration, in line with MAG’s strategy of deploying larger aircraft on selected long-haul routes to boost capacity and improve operating economics. Based on current network planning, they are expected to serve markets across Europe and Asia Pacific, including London, Paris, Sydney, Melbourne, Tokyo, Osaka and Seoul.

Travis Sullivan, President of Boeing Global Southeast Asia, said the order builds on “nearly 80 years of partnership with Malaysia.” Jason Tonich, Chief Commercial Sales and Customer Officer at GE Aerospace, called it “a new chapter” in the engine maker’s nearly three-decade relationship with MAG.

Alongside the order, MAG renewed its agreement for GE Aerospace’s Fuel Insight and FlightPulse software, which it has used for more than five years to identify fuel savings and support operational decisions.

The widebody order adds to MAG’s existing Boeing commitments. Malaysia Airlines operates more than 37 737 Next Generation aircraft and 19 737-8s, and has a total order book of 55 737s, comprising 43 737-8s and 12 737-10s, through a mix of direct orders and leases. The remaining aircraft are due by 2030.

body_zh: 马来西亚航空集团 (MAG) 已直接从波音公司订购 10 架波音 787 梦想飞机，并可选择另外订购 6 架，准备更新其长途机队。
该飞机于 2026 年 11 月 25 日宣布，将由 GE Aerospace GEnx-1B 发动机提供动力，计划于 2032 年至 2035 年期间交付。财务条款未披露。
该协议是在吉隆坡举行的仪式上签署的，马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣出席了仪式。一旦飞机抵达，马来西亚航空将成为第一家运营 787 的马来西亚航空公司。
MAG 总裁兼集团首席执行官 Nasaruddin A. Bakar 机长表示：“收购 787 梦想飞机代表着对马来西亚航空集团未来的战略投资。”他表示，这架飞机将增强该集团“以更大的容量、效率和灵活性”服务主要国际市场的能力。
787 飞机将逐步取代马来西亚航空公司的 7 架空客 A350 飞机，MAG 计划在 2032 年至 2035 年间同期逐步淘汰这些飞机。
新飞机将配备 319 个座位的三舱布局，符合 MAG 在选定的长途航线上部署大型飞机以提高运力和改善运营经济性的战略。根据目前的网络规划，他们预计将服务于欧洲和亚太地区的市场，包括伦敦、巴黎、悉尼、墨尔本、东京、大阪和首尔。
波音全球东南亚区总裁特拉维斯·沙利文 (Travis Sullivan) 表示，该订单建立在“与马来西亚近 80 年的合作伙伴关系”的基础上。 GE 航空航天公司首席商业销售和客户官 Jason Tonich 称，这家发动机制造商与 MAG 近三年的合作关系翻开了“新篇章”。
除了该订单外，MAG 还续签了使用 GE Aerospace 的 Fuel Insight 和 FlightPulse 软件的协议，该软件已使用该软件五年多来确定燃油节省情况并支持运营决策。
宽体机订单增加了 MAG 现有的波音承诺。马来西亚航空通过直接订购和租赁的方式运营着超过 37 737 架下一代飞机和 19 737-8 架飞机，总订单量为 55 737 架，其中包括 43 737-8 架和 12 737-10 架。其余飞机将于 2030 年交付。

title_en: FAA Bans Line Up And Wait Operations “Forever,” With Even More Delays Expected
title_zh: 美国联邦航空局“永远”禁止排队等待操作，预计会有更多延误
summary: The FAA introduces stricter Line Up and Wait rules nationwide from November 24, potentially increasing US airport delays amid controller shortages.
summary_zh: 美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 从 11 月 24 日起在全国范围内引入更严格的排队和等待规则，由于管制员短缺，美国机场的延误可能会增加。
body_en: Experienced ICAO English Language Proficiency Instructor for pilots and ATCOs and conference interpreter who is passionate about facilitating effective communication within aviation-related businesses. Possess a deep understanding of the aviation industry, including aviation regulations, terminology, and industry-specific communication protocols. Has been working at numerous airshows across Europe since 2014. Being an ultralight pilot in her free time, she also promotes safety and efficiency in aviation operations.

The Federal Aviation Administration ( FAA ) has introduced stricter requirements for Line Up and Wait (LUAW) operations at airports across the United States, effective November 24, 2026. The new rules require a dedicated air traffic control supervisor to oversee these operations, potentially preventing controllers at understaffed facilities from using the procedure. The change comes just as millions of Americans prepare to travel for Thanksgiving , raising concerns about longer departure queues and additional flight delays.

Despite reports describing the measure as a permanent nationwide ban, the FAA has not prohibited Line Up and Wait operations altogether. Instead, it has made them conditional on additional staffing, introducing another operational challenge for an air traffic control system already struggling with personnel shortages.
FAA Introduces Stricter Line Up And Wait Rules Nationwide

The new requirement is outlined in FAA Notice JO 7210.979 , which mandates that a standalone watch supervision position must be staffed whenever Line Up and Wait operations are conducted. Previously, the relevant guidance recommended that the local control position should not be combined with other responsibilities. The updated wording makes this a mandatory requirement, meaning supervisors can no longer simultaneously perform other operational duties while overseeing these operations.

Line Up and Wait is a widely used air traffic control procedure that allows aircraft to enter an assigned runway and hold in position while waiting for takeoff clearance. It helps improve runway efficiency because departing aircraft are already positioned when the runway becomes available. However, under the new requirements, airports without sufficient personnel to provide dedicated supervision will have to keep aircraft waiting at taxiway holding points instead. This could reduce departure capacity, particularly during busy periods.

The timing is concerning because November 24 coincides with the beginning of one of America's busiest Thanksgiving travel periods. According to the FAA forecast reported by Traveling for Business , more than 52,000 flights were scheduled for that Tuesday, with over 417,000 expected throughout the nine-day holiday period.
FAA provided a statement to Simple Flying to clarify the new rule

The FAA is taking proactive steps to further strengthen runway safety by enhancing staffing and supervisory requirements for Line Up and Wait (LUAW) at airports nationwide, effective Nov. 24, 2026. These measures ensure dedicated controller staffing and supervisory oversight during LUAW operations and reinforce the FAA’s commitment to maintaining the highest safety standards. This will not impact airport operations.
Dedicated Local Control: The local control position responsible for arriving and departing aircraft must not be combined with any non-local control position.

Stand-Alone Watch Supervision: A dedicated watch supervision position must be staffed and cannot be combined with any other position. This strengthens existing guidance by making stand-alone watch supervision mandatory.
Why The New FAA Requirements Could Cause More Flight Delays

The controversy gained attention after a radio exchange at Albuquerque International Sunport (ABQ). According to TheTravel , a controller told a Southwest Airlines crew about the new nationwide requirement, warning it could slow departures during the busiest travel time of the Thanksgiving rush . The controller described the restriction as something that would last forever, although the FAA's official notice did not use that wording.

Importantly, the FAA's stated objective is to improve runway safety, not reduce airport capacity. Having a dedicated supervisor overseeing operations should help prevent distractions and improve situational awareness when aircraft are positioned on active runways. The FAA's existing procedures also emphasize that Line Up and Wait is not takeoff clearance and that aircraft should not normally remain in that position for more than 90 seconds without further instructions.

But there is also an important clarification: the official notice lists June 9, 2027, as its cancellation date. Therefore, describing the measure as an indefinite or permanent prohibition is misleading. The actual impact will depend on staffing levels at individual towers and how frequently they can provide the additional supervisory position.
Controller Shortages Could Make The New Restrictions Worse

The FAA is attempting to address its longstanding air traffic controller shortage through an ambitious recruitment campaign, including an unusual effort to attract video gamers . In October 2026, the agency announced that it had hired 2,235 controller trainees during the fiscal year , exceeding its recruitment target. The campaign reportedly attracted more than 12,000 qualified applicants within just 24 hours, demonstrating the potential of targeting candidates with strong multitasking and decision-making abilities.

However, recruiting additional candidates does not immediately solve the staffing problem. According to the FAA's 2026 workforce plan , becoming a fully certified controller can take more than two years, depending on the complexity of the assigned facility. The agency has set recruitment targets of 2,300 trainees for fiscal year 2027 and 2,400 for 2028, while expanding training capacity and modernizing its workforce management procedures.

As a result, the new Line Up and Wait requirements could create additional operational pressure before the benefits of increased recruitment become apparent. Although the measure is intended to strengthen runway safety, airports with limited staffing may have fewer opportunities to use an efficiency-enhancing procedure. For Thanksgiving travelers, the immediate concern is that an already busy aviation network could face additional departure bottlenecks during the holiday rush.
body_zh: 经验丰富的国际民航组织飞行员和空中交通管制员英语语言能力讲师以及会议口译员，热衷于促进航空相关业务中的有效沟通。对航空业有深入的了解，包括航空法规、术语和行业特定的通信协议。自 2014 年以来，她一直在欧洲各地的众多航展上工作。作为一名超轻型飞行员，她在业余时间还致力于提高航空运营的安全性和效率。
美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 对美国各地机场的排队等待 (LUAW) 操作提出了更严格的要求，自 2026 年 11 月 24 日起生效。新规则要求专门的空中交通管制主管来监督这些操作，这可能会阻止人手不足的设施的管制员使用该程序。这一变化发生之际，正值数百万美国人准备前往感恩节，引发了人们对出发排队时间更长和航班延误的担忧。
尽管有报道称该措施是全国范围内的永久性禁令，但美国联邦航空局并未完全禁止排队和等待操作。相反，它使他们以增加人员配备为条件，这给已经陷入人员短缺困境的空中交通管制系统带来了另一个运营挑战。
美国联邦航空局在全国范围内推出更严格的排队和等待规则
FAA 通知 JO 7210.979 中概述了新要求，该通知要求在进行排队和等待操作时必须配备独立的值班监督职位。此前，相关指导意见建议，本地控制职位不应与其他职责合并。更新后的措辞使其成为强制性要求，这意味着主管在监督这些操作的同时不能再同时履行其他操作职责。
排队等待是一种广泛使用的空中交通管制程序，允许飞机进入指定的跑道并在等待起飞许可时保持原位。它有助于提高跑道效率，因为当跑道可用时，离场飞机已经就位。然而，根据新要求，没有足够人员进行专门监管的机场将不得不让飞机在滑行道等待点等待。这可能会减少出发容量，尤其是在繁忙时段。
这个时间点令人担忧，因为 11 月 24 日恰逢美国最繁忙的感恩节旅行期之一的开始。根据 Traveling for Business 报道的美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 预测，周二预计有超过 52,000 架次航班，预计整个 9 天假期期间将有超过 417,000 架次航班。
美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）向 Simple Flying 提供了一份声明，以澄清新规则
FAA 正在采取积极措施，通过提高全国机场排队等候 (LUAW) 的人员配备和监管要求，进一步加强跑道安全，该措施将于 2026 年 11 月 24 日生效。这些措施确保在 LUAW 运行期间有专门的管制人员配备和监督，并强化 FAA 对维持最高安全标准的承诺。这不会影响机场运营。
专用本地控制：负责到达和起飞飞机的本地控制位置不得与任何非本地控制位置合并。
独立值班监督：必须配备专门的值班监督职位，且不得与任何其他职位合并。这通过强制执行独立手表监管来加强现有指导。
为什么美国联邦航空局的新要求可能会导致更多航班延误
阿尔伯克基国际太阳港 (ABQ) 的一次无线电交流后，这场争议引起了人们的关注。据 TheTravel 报道，一名管制员向西南航空机组人员介绍了全国范围内的新要求，并警告说，这可能会在感恩节高峰期最繁忙的旅行期间减缓航班起飞速度。管制员称这一限制将永远持续，尽管美国联邦航空局的官方通知并未使用该措辞。
重要的是，美国联邦航空局的既定目标是提高跑道安全，而不是减少机场容量。当飞机位于运行跑道上时，拥有专门的主管来监督运营应该有助于防止分心并提高态势感知能力。 FAA 的现有程序还强调，排队等待并不是起飞许可，并且在没有进一步指示的情况下，飞机通常不应在该位置停留超过 90 秒。
但还有一个重要的澄清：官方通知将2027年6月9日列为取消日期。因此，将该措施描述为无限期或永久禁止是具有误导性的。实际影响将取决于各个塔的人员配备水平以及他们提供额外监管职位的频率。
控制器短缺可能会使新限制变得更糟
美国联邦航空局正试图通过一项雄心勃勃的招聘活动来解决其长期存在的空中交通管制员短缺问题，其中包括采取不同寻常的措施来吸引视频游戏玩家。 2026年10月，该机构宣布在本财年聘用了2,235名控制员实习生，超出了其招聘目标。据报道，该活动在短短 24 小时内就吸引了超过 12,000 名合格的申请者，展示了针对具有强大多任务处理和决策能力的候选人的潜力。
然而，招募更多候选人并不能立即解决人员配备问题。根据 FAA 的 2026 年劳动力计划，成为一名完全认证的管制员可能需要两年多的时间，具体取决于指定设施的复杂程度。该机构设定了 2027 财年招募 2,300 名学员的目标，2028 财年招募 2,400 名学员的目标，同时扩大培训能力并实现劳动力管理程序现代化。
因此，在增加招聘的好处变得明显之前，新的排队和等待要求可能会造成额外的运营压力。尽管该措施旨在加强跑道安全，但人员配备有限的机场可能很少有机会使用提高效率的程序。对于感恩节旅客来说，最紧迫的担忧是本已繁忙的航空网络可能会在假期高峰期间面临额外的出发瓶颈。

title_en: New FAA Rule For Planes Lining Up On Runways May Cause Delays
title_zh: 美国联邦航空局关于飞机在跑道上排队的新规定可能会导致延误
summary: The FAA now requires a dedicated supervisor or controller-in-charge for "line up and wait" runway clearances, and one pilot already thinks that's going to cause delays.
summary_zh: 美国联邦航空局现在需要一名专门的主管或负责管制员来“排队等待”跑道许可，一名飞行员已经认为这将成为现实
body_en: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has just added some new restrictions to how air traffic controllers can clear aircraft to “line up and wait” on the runway, in anticipation of takeoff clearance. This is intended to add an extra safety buffer, but to quote an airline pilot on an ATC frequency, “that’s probably going to cause some delays, that’s for sure.”
New restrictions on planes holding on runway for takeoff

As of today (November 24, 2026), the FAA has introduced a new rule regarding how aircraft can be cleared onto runways at airports. Air traffic controllers want to utilize runways as efficiently as possible for both takeoffs and landings, and that often involves having planes line up on the runway and wait, in anticipation of takeoff clearance.

To give an example, sometimes a plane will be cleared for takeoff, and then a bit of separation is required until the next plane can depart. In those situations, it’s common for the air traffic controller to clear that next plane to “line up and wait.”

The idea is that the plane then has clearance to enter the runway, and then await further takeoff clearance. After all, it might take 30 seconds or so for a plane to taxi from the hold short point of the runway, to getting into position on the runway.

Under the new FAA rules, air traffic controllers will only be allowed to clear pilots to “line up and wait” in situations where there’s a dedicated supervisor or controller-in-charge who can’t perform other duties while these operations are underway. In the past this was a recommendation, but now this is a rule.
Given constant air traffic control staffing shortages, this could actually impact operations a good percentage of the time. Here’s how the reason for this policy change is described

The core purpose of this change is to elevate the safety standard for Line Up and Wait (LUAW) operations by removing ambiguity in staffing requirements. By upgrading the guidance from “should” (a recommendation) to “must” (a mandatory requirement), the FAA ensures that the personnel providing watch supervision (OS/CIC) are fully dedicated to overseeing the safety of the operation without the distraction of simultaneously managing other operational tasks.
How big of a deal is this runway policy change?

I can appreciate the concept behind this, which is to improve safety. After all, we have air traffic controllers who are spread too thin, and all too often, they get a bit distracted due to the volume of things they have to deal with. That has definitely been a contributing factor to many accidents and incidents over the years.

I do find the timing of this being introduced to be interesting, as it comes during one of the busiest travel periods of the year. I don’t think this will actually lead to any major issues, and for that matter, safety shouldn’t be compromised just because flights are busy.

If you’re an observant passenger who is always looking out the window and is on Flightradar24, you may notice this policy in practice, for situations where you feel like the plane should already be lining up on the runway, but isn’t.

I can’t imagine this policy change will lead to any major delays on a widespread basis, but then again, given how at capacity many airports are, even a little change can make a big difference. Below you can hear some talk between an air traffic controller at Albuquerque Airport (ABQ) and a Southwest pilot, where they’re discussing the change. As you can hear, the pilot says “that’s probably going to cause some delays, that’s for sure.”
A new FAA runway safety requirement takes effect across the United States tomorrow, November 24, and an air traffic controller in Albuquerque is already warning pilots about possible delays.
The change requires airports to have a dedicated supervisor on duty before controllers… pic.twitter.com/zxXariHNAy

While the FAA is making changes intended to improve safety, how about also requiring air traffic controllers in the United States to start using standard phraseology, like everywhere else in the world? 😉

As of today, the FAA has added a new restriction on planes being able to line up on runways. A “line up and wait” procedure is pretty standard, but will now only be allowed in situations where the air traffic controller is only focused on one thing. Given how short staffed air traffic control often is, this could have some implications.
I don’t think this will meaningfully slow things down on a national level, but for airports that make the most of every second to get planes in and out, it could definitely have implications.
What do you make of the FAA’s new restrictions on takeoff?
body_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 刚刚对空中交通管制员如何允许飞机在跑道上“排队等待”以等待起飞许可增加了一些新的限制。这样做的目的是增加额外的安全缓冲，但引用一位航空公司飞行员在空中交通管制频率上的话，“这可能会导致一些延误，这是肯定的。”
对飞机在跑道上起飞的新限制
自今天（2026 年 11 月 24 日）起，美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 推出了一项关于如何允许飞机进入机场跑道的新规则。空中交通管制员希望尽可能有效地利用跑道进行起飞和着陆，这通常需要让飞机在跑道上排队等待，以等待起飞许可。
举个例子，有时一架飞机将获准起飞，然后需要进行一些分离，直到下一架飞机可以起飞。在这种情况下，空中交通管制员通常会允许下一架飞机“排队等待”。
这个想法是，飞机随后获得进入跑道的许可，然后等待进一步的起飞许可。毕竟，飞机从跑道的短等待点滑行到进入跑道位置可能需要 30 秒左右的时间。
根据美国联邦航空局的新规定，只有在有专门的主管或负责管制员在这些操作进行期间无法履行其他职责的情况下，空中交通管制员才可以允许飞行员“排队等待”。过去这是建议，但现在这是规则。
鉴于空中交通管制人员持续短缺，这实际上可能会在很大程度上影响运营。以下是此次政策变更的原因描述
此变更的核心目的是通过消除人员配置要求中的模糊性来提高排队等待 (LUAW) 操作的安全标准。通过将指南从“应该”（建议）升级为“必须”（强制性要求），FAA 可确保提供值班监督的人员 (OS/CIC) 完全致力于监督运行安全，而不会因同时管理其他运行任务而分心。
这次跑道政策的改变有多大影响？
我很理解这背后的理念，那就是提高安全性。毕竟，我们的空中交通管制员分布得太分散，而且他们常常因为要处理的事情太多而有点分心。这无疑是多年来发生许多事故和事故的一个因素。
我确实发现引入这一点的时机很有趣，因为它发生在一年中最繁忙的旅行时期之一。我认为这实际上不会导致任何重大问题，就此而言，安全不应仅仅因为航班繁忙而受到损害。
如果您是一位细心的乘客，总是看着窗外，并且使用 Flightradar24，您可能会在实践中注意到此政策，因为您可能会觉得飞机应该已经在跑道上排队，但事实并非如此。
我无法想象这一政策变化会导致大范围的重大延误，但话又说回来，考虑到许多机场的容量，即使是很小的变化也会产生很大的影响。下面您可以听到阿尔伯克基机场 (ABQ) 的空中交通管制员和西南航空飞行员之间的谈话，他们正在讨论这一变化。正如你所听到的，飞行员说：“这可能会导致一些延误，这是肯定的。”
FAA 新的跑道安全要求将于明天（11 月 24 日）在全美生效，阿尔伯克基的一名空中交通管制员已经向飞行员发出可能出现延误的警告。
这一变化要求机场在管制员之前有一名专门的值班主管…… pic.twitter.com/zxXariHNAy
虽然美国联邦航空局正在做出旨在提高安全性的改变，但是否也要求美国的空中交通管制员开始使用标准用语，就像世界其他地方一样？ 😉
截至今天，美国联邦航空局对飞机在跑道上排队增加了新的限制。 “排队等待”程序是相当标准的，但现在只有在空中交通管制员只专注于一件事的情况下才允许。考虑到空中交通管制人员的短缺，这可能会产生一些影响。
我认为这不会在国家层面上显着减缓速度，但对于充分利用每一秒让飞机进出的机场来说，这肯定会产生影响。

title_en: US Army Moves To Restart Washington DC Helicopter Training Flights 2 Years After Deadly Crash
title_zh: 致命坠机事件两年后，美国陆军重新启动华盛顿特区直升机训练飞行
summary: The airspace over Washington DC is some of the most scrutinized airspace in the world.
summary_zh: 华盛顿特区上空的空域是世界上受到最严格审查的空域之一。
body_en: Jack comes to Simple Flying with a lifelong interest in all things aviation. He holds a degree in Aerospace Engineering from Georgia Tech, and is a certified private and remote pilot. Beyond these experiences, Jack previously worked for a corporate flight department where he gained first-hand experience in the world of business aviation. Currently, Jack works in the professional services industry and continues to build his flight hours outside of work.

The US Army is moving to resume helicopter training flights in airspace near Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (DCA) as soon as the week of December 6, according to a recent report by Politico . That timeline comes less than two years after the January 29, 2025 midair collision between an Army Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk and a PSA Airlines regional jet operating as American Airlines Flight 5342 over the Potomac River, a disaster that killed all 67 people aboard both aircraft.

Training operations in the corridor were halted in May 2025 after an Army Black Hawk came too close to Reagan National and forced approaching commercial airliners to abort landings. Resuming training requires Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) approval, and the service had not yet filed a formal request with regulators even as military officials briefed congressional staff on their plans.
Regulatory Barriers Under Current Airspace Rules

Existing FAA regulations explicitly exclude routine training from essential flight categories in the restricted zone around Reagan National. Under interim final rule 2026-01226, which took effect on January 23, 2026, and permanently closed Helicopter Route 4 between Hains Point and the Wilson Bridge, only rare essential flights may enter designated airspace up to 1,500 feet (457 meters) mean sea level. Those narrow exceptions cover lifesaving medical missions, active law enforcement responses to ongoing crimes, national defense or counterintelligence operations, continuity of government, and transport of the President or Vice President.

The rule specifies that proficiency evaluations, routine training, and non-essential personnel transport do not qualify as essential operations. Because the regulation bars routine training inside the designated Potomac zone , military leaders would need either a formal regulatory modification or an approved authorization pathway before standard pilot currency missions resume. FAA officials opened public comment on the interim rule through February 23, 2026, and indicated a final rule would follow after reviewing submissions, eliminated visual separation within five nautical miles (9.3 km) of the airport, increased staffing and oversight, and required air traffic controllers to manage commercial runway use when essential vertical-lift aircraft enter restricted airspace.
Investigation Findings And Fleet Safety Adjustments

Investigations by the National Transportation Safety Board and the Army traced the January 2025 collision to overlapping operational, technical, and airspace vulnerabilities rather than a single error. National Transportation Safety Board findings and reporting by Task & Purpose highlighted tight vertical margins near low-altitude river routes, radio frequency congestion, altimeter instrumentation discrepancies, and bright urban lighting that complicated visual detection at night.

Investigators also noted that radio transmissions that might have helped crews confirm visual separation were missed or complicated by overlapping traffic. The National Transportation Safety Board issued 50 safety recommendations, including eight directed at the Army, and concluded that an Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast system could have alerted the airliner crew 59 seconds before impact. In response, the Army conducted fleet inspections, tested altimeters across Black Hawk variants, and reviewed crew separation procedures. These technical and procedural reviews reflect a broader effort to pair airframe checks with stricter altitude discipline across congested metropolitan corridors.
Labor Resistance And Congressional Legislation

Pushback from aviation labor unions and pending legislation on Capitol Hill complicate the Army's push for a December restart. Association of Flight Attendants president Sara Nelson condemned plans to bring military training back near Reagan National so soon after the fatal crash.

Meanwhile, lawmakers remain divided over final statutory mandates governing shared airspace and traffic-alerting equipment. According to The Washington Sun and Senate Commerce Committee reporting, t he Rotor Operations Transparency and Oversight Reform Act passed the Senate unanimously in December 2025 but stalled in the House, though leaders announced an agreement in principle in mid-November 2026 on a framework to reconcile competing bills before the end of the year. Negotiations involving the House Armed Services Committee remain central to settling how military helicopters and fixed-wing planes share crowded corridors, while commuters and airlines watch whether flight delays or runway adjustments could return. While Senators Ted Cruz and Maria Cantwell push to finish the legislation, unresolved details over military aircraft equipment requirements continue to draw scrutiny from safety advocates and families of the victims.
body_zh: Jack 带着对航空一切事物的终生兴趣加入了 Simple Flying。他拥有佐治亚理工学院的航空航天工程学位，并且是一名经过认证的私人和远程飞行员。除了这些经验之外，杰克还曾在公司飞行部门工作过，在那里他获得了公务航空领域的第一手经验。目前，杰克在专业服务行业工作，并在工作之外继续增加飞行时间。
据 Politico 最近报道，美国陆军最快将于 12 月 6 日这一周恢复在罗纳德·里根华盛顿国家机场 (DCA) 附近空域的直升机训练飞行。这一时间表距离 2025 年 1 月 29 日陆军西科斯基 UH-60 黑鹰飞机与美国航空 5342 号支线飞机在波托马克河上空相撞事件不到两年，这场灾难导致两架飞机上的 67 人全部遇难。
2025 年 5 月，一架陆军黑鹰飞机距离里根国家机场太近，迫使接近的商业客机中止着陆，导致走廊上的训练行动停止。恢复训练需要美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）的批准，尽管军方官员向国会工作人员介绍了他们的计划，但该部门尚未向监管机构提出正式请求。
现行空域规则下的监管障碍

现有的美国联邦航空局法规明确将常规训练排除在里根国家机场周围禁区内的基本飞行类别之外。根据于 2026 年 1 月 23 日生效的临时最终规则 2026-01226，以及永久关闭海恩斯角和威尔逊桥之间的 4 号直升机航线，只有罕见的必要航班可以进入平均海平面 1,500 英尺（457 米）以下的指定空域。这些狭隘的例外包括救生医疗任务、对持续犯罪的积极执法反应、国防或反情报行动、政府连续性以及总统或副总统的交通。

该规则规定，能力评估、日常培训和非必要人员运输不属于必要操作。由于该规定禁止在指定的波托马克区内进行例行训练，因此军事领导人在恢复标准试点货币任务之前需要进行正式的监管修改或批准的授权途径。美国联邦航空局官员在 2026 年 2 月 23 日之前就临时规则公开征求意见，并表示将在审查提交的材料后制定最终规则，消除机场 5 海里（9.3 公里）内的目视间隔，增加人员配备和监督，并要求空中交通管制员在必要的垂直升力飞机进入限制空域时管理商业跑道的使用。
调查结果和车队安全调整
美国国家运输安全委员会和陆军的调查将 2025 年 1 月的碰撞事故追溯到重叠的操作、技术和空域漏洞，而不是单一错误。国家运输安全委员会的调查结果和任务与目的报告强调了低海拔河道附近垂直边距过小、无线电频率拥塞、高度计仪器差异以及明亮的城市照明使夜间视觉检测变得复杂。

调查人员还指出，可能有助于机组人员确认目视分离的无线电传输被错过或因交通重叠而变得复杂。美国国家运输安全委员会发布了 50 项安全建议，其中 8 项针对陆军，并得出结论认为，自动相关监视广播系统可以在撞击前 59 秒向机组人员发出警报。作为回应，陆军进行了舰队检查，测试了黑鹰型号的高度计，并审查了机组人员隔离程序。这些技术和程序审查反映了在拥挤的大都市走廊上将机身检查与更严格的高度纪律结合起来的更广泛的努力。
劳工抵抗和国会立法
来自航空工会的抵制和国会山悬而未决的立法使陆军推动 12 月重新启动的计划变得更加复杂。空乘人员协会主席萨拉·纳尔逊谴责了在致命空难发生后不久就在里根国家公园附近恢复军事训练的计划。

与此同时，立法者对于管理共享空域和交通警报设备的最终法定授权仍存在分歧。据《华盛顿太阳报》和参议院商务委员会报道，《旋翼运营透明度和监督改革法案》于 2025 年 12 月在参议院一致通过，但在众议院陷入停滞，尽管领导人于 2026 年 11 月中旬宣布就年底前协调竞争法案的框架达成原则协议。涉及众议院军事委员会的谈判仍然是解决军用直升机和固定翼飞机如何共享拥挤走廊的核心问题，而通勤者和航空公司则关注航班延误或跑道调整是否会再次出现。尽管参议员特德·克鲁兹和玛丽亚·坎特韦尔推动完成立法，但有关军用飞机设备要求的未解决细节继续引起安全倡导者和受害者家属的密切关注。

Home Miscellaneous Accidents Five killed in Turkish Air Force Cougar training crash
Five crew members died when a Turkish Air Force AS532 Cougar helicopter crashed during a training flight near Eski?ehir on Tuesday evening, 24 November, the Turkish Defence Ministry said.

The helicopter had taken off from Eski?ehir, home to the air force’s 1st Main Jet Base Command. Emergency teams reached the wreckage near Yörükakçay?r, around 15 kilometres west of the city centre. Media footage showed the aircraft’s largely destroyed fuselage.
The ministry initially announced that search and rescue operations were under way before confirming the five fatalities. No cause was disclosed.
It was the Turkish Armed Forces’ second fatal helicopter crash in less than two weeks. On 12 November, an army Sikorsky S-70 crashed near Malatya , killing four crew members.

Eurowings will add Damascus to its network in January 2027, introducing direct flights from Berlin, Düsseldorf, Hamburg and Stuttgart. The services are aimed primarily at passengers visiting family and friends in Syria, with bookings now open.
Düsseldorf will receive two weekly flights, while the other three cities will each have one weekly connection. The planned schedule is
Route to Damascus Launch date Operating days Hamburg 11 January 2027 Mondays Düsseldorf 12 January 2027 Tuesdays and Thursdays Berlin 13 January 2027 Wednesdays Stuttgart 13 January 2027 Wednesdays
The four routes will provide five weekly flights in each direction, with an average journey time of around four and a half hours. Eurowings has not specified the aircraft types in its announcement.

The expansion follows the airline’s recently announced Baghdad services, due to begin in December with two weekly flights each from Berlin and Düsseldorf. Eurowings says its network serving passengers visiting friends and relatives comprises more than 60 routes to over 20 destinations, including Beirut and Erbil.

body_en: Luxair to launch Luxembourg–Riga flights in May 2027 - Aviation24.be

Luxair will begin twice-weekly flights between Luxembourg and Riga on 3 May 2027, becoming a new airline at the Latvian airport. The seasonal service will operate on Mondays and Fridays until the end of October.

The route will be served by Embraer E195-E2 aircraft. According to Riga Airport, it will establish the first direct air connection between the two capitals, following several years of discussions with Luxair.

The airport said the service responds to growing demand for travel between Latvia and Luxembourg, including business, leisure and visits to friends and relatives. Luxair Chief Commercial Officer Thomas Fischer said Riga would add a Baltic city-break destination to the airline’s summer programme.
Tickets went on sale on 24 November through Luxair’s website and other sales channels.

title_zh: ICE 因西雅图喷气桥延误阿拉斯加航空航班而被捕
summary: Two passengers were arrested by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officers while boarding an Alaska Airlines flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on 21 November, delaying the Los Angeles-bound service and drawing criticism from airline, ai
summary_zh: 两名乘客在西雅图-塔科马国际机场搭乘阿拉斯加航空航班时被美国移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 官员逮捕
body_en: ICE arrests on Seattle jet bridge delay Alaska Airlines flight - Aviation24.be

Two passengers were arrested by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officers while boarding an Alaska Airlines flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on 21 November, delaying the Los Angeles-bound service and drawing criticism from airline, airport and elected officials.

The confrontation occurred during boarding for flight AS1306, operated by a Boeing 737-800 registered N592AS. Passenger recordings showed officers restraining travellers on the crowded jet bridge as bystanders shouted. Local public broadcaster KUOW reported that the flight departed nearly three hours late.

Alaska Airlines said it had received no advance notice of the operation and described the incident as distressing for passengers and employees. The carrier said it does not direct or coordinate immigration enforcement and is reviewing whether it followed established procedures. It pledged to work with the Port of Seattle and government authorities on airport safety and coordination practices.

The Port of Seattle, which operates the airport, said immigration enforcement actions take place without its participation or prior knowledge. It expressed outrage over the incident and said it was discussing with the Department of Homeland Security whether previously agreed airport protocols had been breached. The statements reviewed have not publicly established any breach.

Federal authorities identified the detainees as Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza and Sofia Hernandez Mejía, alleging that both had overstayed their visas. DHS also alleged that Hernandez Mejía threw hot coffee at officers during the arrest and said she would face an assault charge. Their lawyer disputes that account.

Attorney Olia Catala told KUOW that the father and daughter entered the United States legally in 2015, held valid work permits and had pending immigration applications. She denied that Hernandez Mejía deliberately threw coffee. KUOW reported on 23 November that federal prosecutors had not yet filed a formal criminal complaint concerning the alleged assault.

Washington Governor Bob Ferguson condemned the tactics, describing the footage as “ horrific and chilling ”. Congressman Adam Smith and Seattle Mayor Katie Wilson also criticised the operation. The incident has prompted scrutiny of how immigration enforcement is conducted during boarding, when passengers and airline staff share a confined area with limited room to move.

body_zh: ICE 因西雅图登机桥延误阿拉斯加航空航班而逮捕 - Aviation24.be
11 月 21 日，两名乘客在西雅图-塔科马国际机场登上阿拉斯加航空的航班时被美国移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 官员逮捕，导致飞往洛杉矶的航班延误，并招致航空公司、机场和民选官员的批评。
冲突发生在登机 AS1306 航班时，该航班由注册号为 N592AS 的波音 737-800 运营。乘客录音显示，警察在拥挤的登机桥上限制旅客，旁观者大喊大叫。当地公共广播公司 KUOW 报道称，该航班晚点了近三个小时。
阿拉斯加航空公司表示，没有收到此次行动的提前通知，并称这一事件让乘客和员工感到痛苦。该航空公司表示，它不指导或协调移民执法，并正在审查是否遵循既定程序。它承诺与西雅图港和政府当局在机场安全和协调实践方面进行合作。
运营该机场的西雅图港表示，移民执法行动是在其参与或事先不知情的情况下进行的。该公司对这一事件表示愤怒，并表示正在与国土安全部讨论是否违反了先前商定的机场协议。所审查的声明尚未公开证实存在任何违规行为。
联邦当局确认被拘留者为里卡多·拉隆多·门多萨和索菲亚·埃尔南德斯·梅希亚，声称两人都已逾期居留。国土安全部还声称，埃尔南德斯·梅希亚在逮捕期间向警察扔热咖啡，并表示她将面临袭击指控。他们的律师对这一说法提出异议。
律师 Olia Catala 告诉 KUOW，这对父女于 2015 年合法进入美国，持有有效的工作许可证，并有待处理的移民申请。她否认埃尔南德斯·梅希亚故意扔咖啡。 KUOW 11 月 23 日报道称，联邦检察官尚未就涉嫌袭击事件提出正式刑事诉讼。
华盛顿州州长鲍勃·弗格森谴责了这种做法，称这段视频“可怕且令人毛骨悚然”。国会议员亚当·史密斯和西雅图市长凯蒂·威尔逊也批评了这次行动。这一事件引发了人们对登机期间移民执法如何进行的审查，当时乘客和航空公司工作人员共享一个活动空间有限的密闭区域。

title_en: Flydubai Resuming Israel Flights After Pilot Tried To Crash Plane Into Airport
title_zh: 飞行员试图将飞机撞入机场后，迪拜航空恢复以色列航班
summary: Israel's transportation minister has approved flydubai's return to Tel Aviv, pending security clearance, after a first officer tried to crash a 737 into Ben Gurion Airport.
summary_zh: 以色列交通部长批准迪拜航空返回特拉维夫，等待安全许可，此前一名副驾驶试图在以色列境内撞毁一架 737 飞机。
body_en: On September 30, 2026, we saw an unbelievably horrifying attempted terror plot , whereby a flydubai Boeing 737 first officer attempted to hijack the plane he was second in command of, and crash it into Tel Aviv’s Ben Gurion Airport .

He attempted to kill the captain of the flight using the axe in the cockpit, but thank goodness the captain managed to open the door after being struck, so that passengers could restrain the first officer. The details that have come out ever since have been downright chilling, including how the Omani pilot had specifically sought out a job at flydubai because the airline flew to Israel, and he wanted to crash into the airport there.

Ever since that incident, flydubai has been banned from flying to Israel. For that matter, air service between Israel and the United Arab Emirates is just a tiny fraction of what it previously was. However, there’s now an update, and it looks like this service could resume very soon.
Israeli authorities pave way for flydubai Tel Aviv return
The Times of Israel reports that Israeli Transportation Minister Miri Regev has approved the resumption of flydubai flights to Israel, pending approval from Israel’s security authorities.

This approval comes after a delegation of Israeli security and transportation officials traveled to Dubai to meet with their counterparts, to discuss new security measures to allow airlines to resume flights between Tel Aviv and Dubai.

Emirati officials reportedly presented the Israeli officials with new steps that have been taken to ensure security in light of the incident, but details beyond that haven’t been made public. Per a statement from the Israeli Transportation Ministry

“The delegation today presented Regev with the steps the company has taken in the wake of the incident. As a result, Regev approved the return of flydubai, subject to clearance from security authorities. The move is a significant step toward restoring air connectivity between Israel and the UAE and expanding flight options for passengers.”

Tel Aviv was flydubai’s single biggest destination, as the airline operated in the market with up to 10 daily flights. Previously, Israeli authorities had banned flydubai from returning to the country through at least December 15, 2026.
Let's talk about that missing rudder of Flydubai 1073 B737 MAX 8.
The aerodynamic forces involved may have been large enough to cause rudder failure through aerodynamic flutter during the extreme overspeed.
The aircraft descended more than 14,000 ft in under 30 seconds.
Turbine Traveller (@Turbinetraveler) September 30, 2026
Expect Israel to closely screen flydubai pilots
Israel is typically known for its very tight security and good intelligence, but obviously there are lapses sometimes.

One of the odd things about the flydubai attempted terror attack is that the Israeli government reportedly had a policy whereby pilots of foreign airlines couldn’t hold citizenship with countries that don’t have diplomatic relations with Israel. Oman and Israel don’t have diplomatic relations, so based on that, the first officer shouldn’t have been able to fly on the plane.

However, it sure seems that there wasn’t actually enforcement of this rule, given that the flydubai first officer had flown to Tel Aviv several times before. I’d imagine that Israeli forces will now much more closely screen the pilots on these flights.
I am curious if there were some new policies put in place beyond that, or if the extent of the enforcement here is that it’s about the potential nationality of pilots.

Israeli authorities have met with their counterparts in the UAE, and the plan is for flydubai to be able to resume flights to Israel in the near future. This comes nearly two months after the awful terror plot, whereby a flydubai pilot intended to kill the captain, and then fly a 737 full of passengers into the terminal at Ben Gurion Airport.

Some new security policies have reportedly been put into place, though the details of that aren’t being made public. I think one thing is for sure — Israeli authorities will carefully be scrutinizing manifests and keeping an eye on the pilots at the controls of these flights.
body_zh: 2026 年 9 月 30 日，我们目睹了一场令人难以置信的恐怖未遂阴谋，一名迪拜航空波音 737 副机长试图劫持他副机长的飞机，并将其撞入特拉维夫的本古里安机场。
他试图在驾驶舱内用斧头杀死机长，但幸亏机长在被击中后设法打开了舱门，以便乘客能够制止副驾驶。此后曝光的细节令人毛骨悚然，包括阿曼飞行员如何专门在迪拜航空寻找工作，因为该航空公司飞往以色列，他想撞入那里的机场。
自那次事件发生以来，迪拜航空已被禁止飞往以色列。就此而言，以色列和阿拉伯联合酋长国之间的航空服务只是以前的一小部分。不过，现在有了更新，看来这项服务很快就会恢复。
以色列当局为迪拜航空返回特拉维夫铺平道路
据《以色列时报》报道，以色列交通部长 Miri Regev 已批准恢复迪拜航空飞往以色列的航班，尚待以色列安全部门批准。
这一批准是在以色列安全和运输官员代表团前往迪拜与同行会面，讨论新的安全措施以允许航空公司恢复特拉维夫和迪拜之间的航班之后获得的。
据报道，阿联酋官员向以色列官员介绍了针对该事件为确保安全而采取的新措施，但除此之外的细节尚未公开。根据以色列交通部的声明
以色列媒体援引交通部声明报道称，“代表团今天向雷格夫介绍了该公司在事件发生后采取的措施”。 “因此，雷格夫批准了迪拜航空的回归，但须得到安全部门的许可。”
特拉维夫是迪拜航空最大的单一目的地，该航空公司每天有多达 10 趟航班在该市场运营。此前，以色列当局已禁止迪拜航空至少在 2026 年 12 月 15 日之前返回该国。
我们来谈谈迪拜航空 1073 B737 MAX 8 丢失的方向舵。
所涉及的空气动力可能足够大，足以在极端超速期间通过空气动力颤振导致方向舵失效。
飞机在 30 秒内下降了 14,000 多英尺。
涡轮旅行者 (@Turbinetraveler) 2026 年 9 月 30 日
预计以色列将严密筛查迪拜航空飞行员
以色列通常以其非常严格的安全和良好的情报而闻名，但显然有时也会出现失误。
关于迪拜航空未遂恐怖袭击的一个奇怪的事情是，据报道，以色列政府有一项政策，规定外国航空公司的飞行员不能持有与以色列没有外交关系的国家的公民身份。阿曼和以色列没有外交关系，因此，副驾驶不应该乘坐这架飞机。
然而，考虑到这位迪拜航空副驾驶之前曾多次飞往特拉维夫，这一规定似乎并未得到实际执行。我想以色列军队现在将更加严格地筛查这些航班上的飞行员。
我很好奇除此之外是否还制定了一些新政策，或者这里的执行程度是否与飞行员的潜在国籍有关。
以色列当局已与阿联酋同行会面，计划迪拜航空能够在不久的将来恢复飞往以色列的航班。这发生在可怕的恐怖阴谋发生近两个月后，一名迪拜航空飞行员意图杀死机长，然后驾驶一架满载乘客的 737 飞机进入本古里安机场航站楼。
据报道，一些新的安全政策已经到位，但细节尚未公开。我认为有一件事是肯定的——以色列当局将仔细审查乘客名单，并密切关注控制这些航班的飞行员。

title_en: Why The US Military Is Expanding A Remote Pacific Airport To Reduce Its Reliance On Guam
title_zh: 为什么美国军方正在扩建偏远的太平洋机场以减少对关岛的依赖
summary: Yap is returning from geostrategic obscurity to prominence in US and Chinese rivalry in the Pacific, with its airport set to be transformed.
summary_zh: 雅浦岛正在从地缘战略上的默默无闻重新成为美国和中国在太平洋地区竞争中的重要人物，其机场也将进行改造。
body_en: Aaron is an aviation enthusiast and world traveler with a deep interest in aerospace history and technology. He has traveled around the world numerous times, often incorporating visits to aviation museums and historic aircraft collections into his journeys. A native of New Zealand, he is an expert in aviation and maintains a broad interest in a variety of other subjects.

In October and November, I visited the Micronesian island countries of Palau and the Federated States of Micronesia (FSM). The FSM consists of four states: Yap, Chuuk, Pohnpei, and Kosrae. I visited Yap, whose airport is set to receive some major work by the United States to prepare it for war as part of the USAF's broader Agile Combat Employment (ACE) doctrine to disperse aircraft from Guam. Separately, US Navy personnel on the island informed me that there are plans to dredge the island's harbor to allow large warships to berth. Funding has not yet been approved.

When I visited, work on the airport had not yet started, and the US military footprint on the island was minimal. The hotel I stayed at houses around half the personnel (mostly US Navy) on the island for periods of six months. I arrived in Yap from Palau, where the minor airfield of Peleliu was closed because major construction work to expand the airport for ACE operations was underway . Here is what to know about the US's plans to expand Yap International Airport to relieve wartime strain on Andersen Air Force Base in Guam.

The knowledge that Yap Island's airport was soon to be transformed was surreal. The island is one of the remote islands in the Pacific and is difficult and expensive to reach. Adjacent to the international airport is an old Japanesee WWII airfield littered with aircraft destroyed by American bombing and lost to the jungle. I found around eight Japanese airplanes, some marked, some not marked. Here and there around the islands are the remains of lost US Vought F4U Corsairs and bombers.

Today, the island feels like a world away, but the USAF plans to improve the airports and airfields on the Second Island Chain as competition with China heats up. The echoes from WWII are clear. In 1944, the US island-hopped to Japan to project airpower over the Japanese home islands.

Now those same islands are needed to project airpower over the First Island Chain. The First Island Chain includes Taiwan, Japan's southern islands, and the Philippines. Following WWII, the US consolidated its airpower and military bases on Guam, while maintaining forward bases in Japan and Korea. The rise of China puts not only those forward bases at risk, but also Guam, which is now a prime target. Without Guam, or an effective alternative, the US's ability to project airpower over the region would diminish drastically.

The WWII US invasion of the island of Peleliu was one of the deadliest operations for the US Marines during the Pacific War. Fortunately for the native Yapese, the island was not invaded. Instead, it was intensively bombed, bypassed, and rendered irrelevant. Japanese forces remained on the island until the surrender. Most of their aircraft were destroyed in air campaigns.

The Japanese airfield is now abandoned and overgrown, but next to it, Yap International Airport operates. Yap Airport is a simple single-runway airport with a basic terminal building. The only scheduled passenger flights that use the airport are United Airlines and Pacific Missionary Aviation (PMA) United operates 737 MAX 8 flights from Guam twice weekly ; this is the primary connection to the outside world. Outside of United's flights, Yap's terminal building is generally closed.

PMA operates passenger flights once a week (soon to be twice) from neighboring Palau using its two Super King Airs (seven to nine seats, depending on freight). PMA also operates flights to Yap's outlying islands as well as MEDEVAC and emergency services. I flew the PMA passenger flight from Palau to Yap, was invited on a flight to an outlying island (Ulithi), and flew out on United. PMA operates from its own private hangar and operates domestic flights from there. International (Palau) flights run through the main terminal.

Funding for Yap Airport's transformation appears in two main categories: civilian FAA Airport Improvement Program (AIP) grants and the Department of Defense/Air Force military construction and related funding. The Air Force's Fiscal Year 2025 Military Construction budget request included around $400 million for runway extension and related work. This is labeled " PDI: Runway Extension, Inc. " in the documents. The first increment funding is $96 million.

A modest reduction appears in Fiscal 2027 documents with the explanatory note, " Program execution encountered delays and slipped from FY2025 to FY2026, funding reflects the one-time decrease after increase to support acquisition of land for an agreed upon defense site under appropriate international agreement required to complete the runway extension, parking apron, and taxiway construction at Yap International Airport, Wake Island ."

The decrease is $31 million, but as the note includes Wake Island, it is unclear how much of this is relevant to Yap. The justification language for the funding emphasizes the need for a longer runway and facilities to support larger military aircraft for training, operations, contingency, and Agile Combat Employment. In the event of a high-end conflict with China, this likely means that Yap will be on China's list of strategic targets to be hit and neutralized.

The United States is currently upgrading numerous airports and airfields across the Second Island Chain as part of its ACE doctrine and preparations to counter China. As stated, one of the most significant programs currently underway is rehabilitating Palau's Peleliu airfield, while Angaur Airfield is already complete. On Guam, the USAF is expanding parking areas on its primary Andersen Air Force Base and rehabilitating its adjacent, formerly abandoned Northwest Field.

One of the biggest areas of effort is on the island of Tinian in the Northern Mariana Islands. There, the USAF is expanding and rehabilitating Tinian International Airport and the formerly abandoned North Field. Nearby, the island of Rota (home to fewer than 2,000 inhabitants) has also been an area of interest and increased military exercises. The civil airports on Palau, Saipan, and Guam also factor into US ACE planning, even if no work is being carried out to expand them.
Select Micronesian airports/airfields being expanded for ACE (per budget documents )

One important effort is Australia. Australia is not part of the Second Island Chain, and the relationship with Washington is very different from that of small Pacific islands. In Australia, effort is mostly focused on Australia's northern RAAF bases: Tindal, RAAF Darwin, and possibly RAAF Amberley. These are being prepped primarily for US strategic bomber use with associated aerial tankers.
body_zh: 亚伦是一位航空爱好者和环球旅行家，对航空航天历史和技术有着浓厚的兴趣。他曾多次环游世界，经常在旅途中参观航空博物馆和历史飞机收藏。他是新西兰人，是航空专家，并对其他各种学科保持着广泛的兴趣。
10月和11月，我访问了密克罗尼西亚岛国帕劳和密克罗尼西亚联邦。密克罗尼西亚联邦由四个州组成：雅浦州、楚克州、波纳佩州和科斯雷州。我访问了雅浦岛，该机场将接受美国的一些重大工程，为战争做好准备，这是美国空军更广泛的敏捷作战部署 (ACE) 原则的一部分，旨在驱散来自关岛的飞机。另外，岛上的美国海军人员告诉我，有计划疏浚该岛港口，以便大型军舰停泊。资金尚未获得批准。
我访问时，机场工程尚未开始，美军在岛上的足迹也很小。我住的酒店住了岛上大约一半的人员（主要是美国海军）六个月。我从帕劳抵达雅浦，那里的贝里琉岛小型机场已关闭，因为为 ACE 运营而扩建机场的主要建设工程正在进行中。以下是有关美国计​​划扩建雅浦国际机场以缓解关岛安德森空军基地战时压力的信息。
当得知雅浦岛机场即将改造时，我感到超现实。该岛是太平洋上的偏远岛屿之一，到达该岛既困难又昂贵。毗邻国际机场的是一个古老的日本二战机场，里面散落着被美国轰炸摧毁并消失在丛林中的飞机。我发现了大约八架日本飞机，有些有标记，有些没有标记。岛屿周围随处可见失踪的美国沃特 F4U 海盗机和轰炸机的残骸。
如今，这座岛屿感觉像是一个遥远的世界，但随着与中国的竞争加剧，美国空军计划改善第二岛链上的机场和机场。二战的回响是清晰的。 1944年，美国跳岛前往日本，向日本本土投送空中力量。
现在，需要这些岛屿来向第一岛链投送空中力量。第一岛链包括台湾、日本南部岛屿和菲律宾。二战后，美国巩固了在关岛的空军和军事基地，同时在日本和韩国保留了前沿基地。中国的崛起不仅使这些前沿基地面临风险，也使目前成为主要目标的关岛面临风险。如果没有关岛或有效的替代方案，美国在该地区投送空中力量的能力将大幅削弱。
二战期间美国入侵贝里琉岛是太平洋战争期间美国海军陆战队伤亡最惨重的行动之一。对于当地的雅浦人来说幸运的是，该岛没有受到入侵。相反，它遭到了密集的轰炸、绕过，并变得无关紧要。日军一直留在岛上直到投降。他们的大部分飞机在空战中被摧毁。
日本机场现已废弃且杂草丛生，但在其旁边，雅浦国际机场仍在运营。雅浦机场是一个简单的单跑道机场，设有基本的航站楼。使用该机场的唯一定期客运航班是美国联合航空 (United Airlines) 和太平洋传教航空 (PMA)，联合航空运营 737 MAX 8 航班，每周两次从关岛出发；这是与外界的主要联系。除了美联航的航班外，雅浦机场的航站楼通常处于关闭状态。
PMA 使用其两架超级国王航空（7 至 9 个座位，具体取决于货运量）每周运营一次（很快将增加两次）从邻国帕劳出发的客运航班。 PMA 还运营飞往雅浦岛离岛的航班以及医疗后送和紧急服务。我搭乘 PMA 客运航班从帕劳飞往雅浦，受邀搭乘飞往离岛 (Ulithi) 的航班，然后搭乘美联航航班出发。 PMA 拥有自己的私人机库，并从那里运营国内航班。国际（帕劳）航班经过主航站楼。
雅浦机场改造的资金主要分为两大类：民用美国联邦航空局机场改进计划 (AIP) 拨款以及国防部/空军军事建设及相关资金。空军 2025 财年军事建设预算请求包括约 4 亿美元用于跑道扩建和相关工程。在文档中，这被标记为“PDI：跑道延伸公司”。首期增量资金为9600万美元。
2027 财年文件中出现了适度的减少，并附有解释性说明：“计划执行遇到延误，从 2025 财年下滑至 2026 财年，资金增加后出现了一次性减少，以支持根据适当的国际协议为商定的防御场地购置土地，以完成威克岛雅浦国际机场的跑道延伸、停机坪和滑行道建设。”
减少额为 3100 万美元，但由于该票据包括威克岛，因此尚不清楚其中有多少与 Yap 有关。资金的理由语言强调需要更长的跑道和设施来支持更大的军用飞机进行训练、作战、应急和敏捷作战部署。如果与中国发生高端冲突，这可能意味着雅浦岛将被列入中国要打击和压制的战略目标清单。
美国目前正在升级第二岛链上的众多机场和简易机场，作为其 ACE 原则和对抗中国的准备工作的一部分。如前所述，目前正在进行的最重要的计划之一是修复帕劳的贝里琉机场，而安加尔机场已经完工。在关岛，美国空军正在扩大其主要安德森空军基地的停车区，并修复邻近的、以前废弃的西北机场。
最大的努力地区之一是北马里亚纳群岛的天宁岛。在那里，美国空军正在扩建和修复天宁岛国际机场和以前废弃的北机场。附近的罗塔岛（居民不到 2,000 人）也是一个令人感兴趣的地区，军事演习也有所增加。帕劳、塞班岛和关岛的民用机场也纳入了美国 ACE 规划，尽管目前尚未开展扩建工作。
选择为 ACE 扩建的密克罗尼西亚机场/机场（根据预算文件）
其中一项重要努力是澳大利亚。澳大利亚不属于第二岛链，与华盛顿的关系与太平洋小岛的关系有很大不同。在澳大利亚，工作重点主要集中在澳大利亚北部的澳大利亚皇家空军基地：廷达尔、澳大利亚皇家空军达尔文基地，可能还有澳大利亚皇家空军安伯利基地。这些主要是为美国战略轰炸机与相关空中加油机一起使用而准备的。

Home Boeing Boeing Defense Boeing wins contract for 15 additional USAF KC-46A tankers
Boeing has received a US Air Force contract for 15 additional KC-46A Pegasus aerial refuelling aircraft, bringing the programme’s combined contracted and delivered total to 203 aircraft worldwide.

Announcing the award on 24 November, Boeing said it had delivered 116 KC-46As to the US Air Force, six to the Japan Air Self-Defense Force and two to the Israeli Air Force. The company did not disclose the contract value or delivery schedule.

The US Air Force fleet has accumulated more than 180,000 flight hours since its first aircraft was delivered in 2019, according to Boeing, covering training, operational sorties and overseas deployments.

Alongside aerial refuelling, the KC-46A can be reconfigured for transport and humanitarian missions. Boeing highlighted recent aid deliveries and joint training involving US and Japanese forces as examples of its operational use.

title_en: American Airlines Drops Chicago Gate Lawsuit, But Doubles Down On Turf War With United
title_zh: 美国航空放弃芝加哥登机口诉讼，但加大与联合航空的地盘争夺战
summary: American Airlines is abandoning its legal challenge over Chicago's gate redistribution, but its battle with United is far from over.
summary_zh: 美国航空正在放弃对芝加哥登机口重新分配的法律挑战，但与联合航空的斗争还远未结束。
body_en: Paul has had a career of 25+ years focused on the international technology sector, which has taken him to over 100 countries. Along the way, he developed a deep love for aviation, with a travel bucket list measured by aircraft types flown rather than destinations reached. Now he brings that avgeek passion, along with the journalism experience he accumulated early in his career, to write insightful pieces for Simple Flying.

American Airlines is dropping its lawsuit against the City of Chicago and United Airlines over the controversial redistribution of gates at Chicago O'Hare International Airport (ORD). The decision follows an unsuccessful appeal last week, bringing the carrier's 18-month legal battle over the allocation of airport infrastructure toward a close.

However, American is arguably in a stronger competitive position at O'Hare than when it first launched its legal challenge. The airline has recovered gate space, significantly expanded its network, and announced further investments in its third-largest hub. Nevertheless, Reuters reports that United's continued dominance in Chicago presents a considerable obstacle to American's ambitions of rebuilding a profitable operation.
American Airlines Brings Its Legal Battle To An End

In a court filing dated November 20 , as reported by View From The Wing, American requested that its entire complaint be dismissed with prejudice, meaning it would be unable to pursue the same claims again, including those for financial damages. Neither Chicago nor United opposes the motion, with each party bearing its own legal expenses under the proposed dismissal. American explained its decision in a statement to View From The Wing
“We stand by our decision to advocate for a fair process, and today, we believe the best way to continue delivering on that commitment is to look ahead.”

The dispute originated in O'Hare's 2018 Airline Use and Lease Agreement (AULA), which allows gates to be redistributed according to airlines' flight activity. American argued that delays in delivering additional gates in Concourse L meant that a contractually agreed expansion period had not been fulfilled, precluding any redistribution until 2027. Unsurprisingly, the City of Chicago and United disagreed.
Chicago adopts a new lease agreement, allowing periodic gate redistribution based on airlines' shares of departures.
Delta's relocation to Terminal 5 triggers a protected expansion period. American's anticipated additional Concourse L gates remain unavailable.
At United's request, Chicago begins redistributing gate space based on 2024 flight activity.
American sues Chicago in federal court, seeking to prevent redistribution until April 2027.
Chicago finalizes the new allocations, with American losing four gates and United gaining five.
United joins the federal case, raising jurisdictional issues. American withdraws that case and files a state court complaint on July 16.
Following a seven-day hearing, the court denies American's request for an injunction to block the redistribution.
The revised gate allocations take effect, strengthening United's position at O'Hare. American appeals the denial of its preliminary injunction.
Chicago and United submit their formal responses to American's complaint.
Proceedings on the underlying complaint are suspended pending resolution of the appeal.
The appellate court upholds the injunction denial, citing the balance of harm to airlines, passengers and airport operations.
American moves to permanently dismiss its complaint, including its outstanding damages claims.
Sources: Illinois Appellate Court ruling , American's dismissal motion and Chicago Department of Aviation.
body_zh: Paul 拥有超过 25 年的职业生涯，专注于国际技术领域，足迹遍及 100 多个国家。一路走来，他对航空产生了深深的热爱，他的旅行愿望清单是根据飞行的飞机类型而不是到达的目的地来衡量的。现在，他带着这种平均极客的热情，以及他在职业生涯早期积累的新闻经验，为《简单飞行》撰写了富有洞察力的文章。
美国航空 (American Airlines) 放弃对芝加哥市和联合航空 (United Airlines) 因芝加哥奥黑尔国际机场 (ORD) 登机口重新分配而引发争议的诉讼。该决定是在上周上诉失败后作出的，这使得该航空公司长达 18 个月的机场基础设施分配法律战接近尾声。
然而，与首次发起法律挑战时相比，美国航空在奥黑尔国际法院可以说处于更强大的竞争地位。该航空公司已经恢复了登机口空间，显着扩展了其网络，并宣布对其第三大枢纽进行进一步投资。尽管如此，路透社报道称，联合航空在芝加哥的持续主导地位对美国航空重建盈利业务的雄心构成了相当大的障碍。
美国航空结束法律斗争
据 View From The Wing 报道，美国航空在 11 月 20 日提交的一份法庭文件中要求驳回其整个投诉，这意味着该公司将无法再次提出同样的索赔，包括经济损失索赔。芝加哥和曼联都不反对这项动议，双方根据提议的解雇承担各自的法律费用。美国航空在给 View From The Wing 的一份声明中解释了其决定
“我们坚持倡导公平流程的决定，今天，我们相信继续兑现这一承诺的最佳方式就是展望未来。”
争议起源于奥黑尔机场的2018年航空公司使用和租赁协议（AULA），该协议允许根据航空公司的航班活动重新分配登机口。美国航空辩称，延迟在 L 大厅交付额外登机口意味着合同约定的扩建期限尚未履行，因此无法在 2027 年之前进行任何重新分配。不出所料，芝加哥市和美联航不同意。
芝加哥采用了新的租赁协议，允许根据航空公司的起飞份额定期重新分配登机口。
达美航空搬迁至 5 号航站楼引发了受保护的扩张期。美国航空预计增加的 L 大厅登机口仍然无法使用。
应美联航的要求，芝加哥开始根据 2024 年的航班活动重新分配登机口空间。
美国航空公司在联邦法院起诉芝加哥，寻求在 2027 年 4 月之前阻止重新分配。
芝加哥最终确定了新的分配，美国航空失去了四个大门，而曼联则获得了五个大门。
联合航空加入联邦案件，引发了管辖权问题。美国航空撤回该案，并于 7 月 16 日向州法院提起诉讼。
经过为期 7 天的听证会后，法院驳回了美国航空公司提出的禁止重新分配禁令的请求。
修改后的登机口分配生效，加强了曼联在奥黑尔的地位。美国航空公司对其初步禁令被驳回提出上诉。
芝加哥航空和曼联航空对美国航空的投诉做出了正式回应。
基本投诉的诉讼程序已暂停，等待上诉得到解决。
上诉法院维持了禁令的驳回，理由是对航空公司、乘客和机场运营造成的损害平衡。
美国航空采取行动永久驳回其投诉，包括其未决的损害索赔。
资料来源：伊利诺伊州上诉法院裁决、美国航空的驳回动议和芝加哥航空部。

title_en: Where To Spot The Air France Airbus A318 Before It Finally Retires
title_zh: 在法航空客 A318 最终退役之前，在哪里可以看到它
summary: This is where Air France is flying its final Airbus A318s before retirement.
summary_zh: 这是法航退役前最后一架空客 A318 飞机的飞行地点。
body_en: Based in Maastricht, the Netherlands, Nick joined Simple Flying in October 2025 and has a strong passion for travel and tourism, and in particular, the aviation industry, for as long as he can remember. Nick's focus is on aviation economics, airline strategy, and digital innovation. Before joining Simple Flying, he gained industry experience in ground handling and in a leading European airline group. Academically, Nick holds a Bachelor's degree in Aviation Management and is currently pursuing a Master's degree in Strategy & Innovation.

Air France 's Airbus A318 was due to disappear from scheduled passenger service on November 8, but its retirement has been pushed back to March 27, 2027. The airline's remaining aircraft are still operating from Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG), with Marseille (MRS), Toulouse (TLS), Bordeaux (BOD), Nice (NCE), Milan Linate (LIN), and Lyon (LYS) offering some of the most frequent opportunities to catch the type.

Using data from the Simple Flying Flight Tracker , we analyzed 423 A318 flights between October 12 and November 8. The four aircraft visited 30 airports during those four weeks. One stopped appearing after October 20, although it has since returned to service. Their movements provide a useful indication of where and when to look, particularly for anyone planning a visit to Paris in the coming months.
The A318 Is Now Scheduled To Remain Until March 2027

The smallest member of the Airbus A320 family has already received several extensions to its service life with Air France. Last summer, the carrier extended planned A318 operations from November 8, 2026, until March 27, 2027 . The revised timetable covers domestic French routes and a selection of intra-European destinations, with all the scheduled services operating through CDG.

However, March 27 is the final date currently shown in the published schedule rather than a confirmed farewell flight. Aircraft assignments can also change independently of the route timetable, meaning the presence of an A318 in a booking system does not guarantee that passengers will actually travel on one. For spotters, recent movements are consequently more useful than relying entirely on flights advertised several months ahead.

Air France has continued replacing its smaller A320-family aircraft with the Airbus A220-300. On November 6, the airline received its 60th A220 , registered F-HOZJ, which subsequently entered passenger service on November 9. The new aircraft seats 148 passengers, compared with 131 on the A318, and is now used across much of the airline's European network. Nevertheless, the four remaining A318s continue to appear in daily operations.
France's Largest Cities Offer The Best Opportunities

The busiest A318 route during our four-week analysis was between CDG and Marseille Provence Airport (MRS), with 69 recorded flights in both directions. Of these, 35 departed Paris and 34 returned from Marseille. Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) came second with 47 flights, followed by Bordeaux–Mérignac Airport (BOD) with 42. Together, these three domestic connections accounted for 158 flights, or more than a third of the total activity recorded.

Nice Côte d'Azur Airport (NCE) was the fourth most frequently visited destination, with 28 flights. The leading international route was Milan Linate Airport (LIN), with 22, while Lyon–Saint Exupéry Airport (LYS) recorded 20. These six routes accounted for 228 of the 423 flights, making them the most useful starting points for anyone trying to photograph the aircraft away from CDG. The figures reflect actual recorded movements, not the number of A318 flights scheduled in the months ahead.

Marseille is particularly interesting because the A318 appeared on several different rotations rather than being restricted to a single flight number. AF7344 was recorded ten times from Paris during the analysis, while AF7336 appeared on eight departures. The late-evening AF7344 also operated with F-GUGP on November 21, according to subsequent flight history.
The Four Aircraft Reached 30 Airports In Four Weeks

Despite their small number, the A318s were used across a geographically diverse network. We identified 30 different airports in 12 countries between October 12 and November 8, including CDG itself. France accounted for nine of these airports, while the aircraft also visited five in Italy, four in Spain, and two in Portugal. Outside these markets, the tracking data included destinations such as Amsterdam (AMS), Copenhagen (CPH), Warsaw (WAW), Munich (MUC), Prague (PRG), and Bergen (BGO).

The aircraft were not limited to routes typically associated with the French domestic network. Recorded international flights include Paris to Casablanca Mohammed V International Airport (CMN), Málaga (AGP), and Ibiza Airport (IBZ). Bergen Airport (BGO) also appeared in the data, although each of these destinations was served far less frequently than the main domestic routes. A route appearing once or twice in four weeks should not be interpreted as a dependable spotting opportunity.

Unsurprisingly, of the 423 recorded flights, 422 either departed from or arrived at CDG. The exception was a one-off flight between Bologna (BLQ) and Venice (VCE) on November 6. The French hub airport therefore remains the most obvious location for seeing one without having to predict its next destination, although the timing of a visit makes a substantial difference.

As each of the active A318s generally completes around five flights on a flying day, the aircraft make repeated appearances at CDG throughout the day. Our tracking data contains 213 departures from the airport during the 28-day period, equivalent to an average of approximately eight daily departures across the remaining fleet. These were not evenly distributed across the day, however, and several periods offered considerably more activity than others.

The most useful morning window was between 7:00 AM and 8:59 AM local time, when 49 A318 departures were recorded. Another 44 departures took place between noon and 1:59 PM, while 49 occurred between 6:00 PM and 9:59 PM. The later flights are less useful for photography during the winter months, although they provide additional opportunities for anyone primarily interested in watching or flying the aircraft.

Particularly at CDG, it is worth following the registration rather than concentrating on just one scheduled departure. An A318 arriving from Bordeaux, Marseille, or Milan may continue to an entirely different destination after its turnaround. Watching the aircraft's inbound sector can therefore help establish whether the same airframe is likely to operate the next flight, rather than waiting for a single flight number that may be assigned another type.
body_zh: Nick 居住在荷兰马斯特里赫特，于 2025 年 10 月加入 Simple Flying，从他记事起，他就对旅行和旅游业，特别是航空业充满热情。尼克的重点是航空经济学、航空公司战略和数字创新。在加入 Simple Flying 之前，他在地勤方面和欧洲领先的航空公司集团中积累了行业经验。在学术上，尼克拥有航空管理学士学位，目前正在攻读战略与创新硕士学位。
法航的空客 A318 原定于 11 月 8 日从定期客运服务中消失，但其退役日期已推迟至 2027 年 3 月 27 日。该航空公司剩余的飞机仍在巴黎戴高乐机场 (CDG) 运营，其中马赛 (MRS)、图卢兹 (TLS)、波尔多 (BOD)、尼斯 (NCE)、米兰利纳特 (LIN) 和里昂 (LYS) 提供了一些最频繁的航班抓住类型。
使用 Simple Flying Flight Tracker 的数据，我们分析了 10 月 12 日至 11 月 8 日期间的 423 架 A318 航班。这四个星期内，这四架飞机访问了 30 个机场。其中一架在 10 月 20 日之后就不再出现，但后来又恢复使用。他们的动作提供了有用的指示，告诉人们去哪里、何时去寻找，特别是对于那些计划在未来几个月内访问巴黎的人来说。
A318 现计划保留至 2027 年 3 月
空客 A320 系列中最小的成员已经获得法航的多次延长使用寿命。去年夏天，该航空公司将计划中的 A318 运营时间从 2026 年 11 月 8 日延长至 2027 年 3 月 27 日。修订后的时刻表涵盖法国国内航线和精选的欧洲内部目的地，所有定期航班均通过戴高乐机场运营。
然而，3 月 27 日是目前公布的时间表中显示的最终日期，而不是确认的告别航班。飞机分配也可能独立于航线时刻表而变化，这意味着预订系统中存在 A318 并不能保证乘客实际上会乘坐 A318。对于观察者来说，最近的动态比完全依赖几个月前公布的航班更有用。
法航继续用空客 A220-300 替换其较小的 A320 系列飞机。 11 月 6 日，该航空公司接收了第 60 架 A220，注册号为 F-HOZJ，随后于 11 月 9 日投入客运服务。新飞机可容纳 148 名乘客，而 A318 为 131 名乘客，目前在该航空公司的大部分欧洲网络中使用。尽管如此，剩下的四架 A318 仍继续出现在日常运营中。
法国最大的城市提供最好的机会
在我们为期 4 周的分析中，最繁忙的 A318 航线是戴高乐机场和马赛普罗旺斯机场 (MRS) 之间的航线，有 69 个双向航班记录。其中，35人从巴黎出发，34人从马赛返回。图卢兹布拉尼亚克机场 (TLS) 以 47 架次航班位居第二，其次是波尔多梅里尼亚克机场 (BOD)，有 42 架次。这三个国内航线合计起 158 架次航班，占记录总数的三分之一以上。
尼斯蓝色海岸机场 (NCE) 是第四大最常访问的目的地，有 28 个航班。领先的国际航线是米兰利纳特机场 (LIN)，有 22 架次，而里昂圣埃克絮佩里机场 (LYS) 则有 20 架次。这 6 条航线占 423 趟航班中的 228 趟，对于那些试图在戴高乐机场以外拍摄飞机的人来说，它们是最有用的起点。这些数字反映的是实际记录的航班流量，而不是未来几个月计划的 A318 航班数量。
马赛特别有趣，因为 A318 出现在多个不同的轮换中，而不是仅限于单一航班号。在分析过程中，AF7344 被记录了 10 次从巴黎出发的航班，而 AF7336 则出现了 8 次从巴黎出发的航班。根据随后的飞行历史记录，这架深夜的 AF7344 也在 11 月 21 日与 F-GUGP 一起运营。
四架飞机四周内抵达30个机场

尽管数量不多，但 A318 的使用范围遍及不同地理位置的网络。我们在 10 月 12 日至 11 月 8 日期间确定了 12 个国家/地区的 30 个不同机场，其中包括戴高乐机场本身。其中法国机场占 9 个，飞机还访问了意大利的 5 个、西班牙的 4 个和葡萄牙的 2 个。在这些市场之外，跟踪数据还包括阿姆斯特丹 (AMS)、哥本哈根 (CPH)、华沙 (WAW)、慕尼黑 (MUC)、布拉格 (PRG) 和卑尔根 (BGO) 等目的地。
这些飞机并不局限于通常与法国国内网络相关的航线。已记录的国际航班包括巴黎飞往卡萨布兰卡穆罕默德五世国际机场 (CMN)、马拉加 (AGP) 和伊维萨机场 (IBZ)。卑尔根机场 (BGO) 也出现在数据中，尽管这些目的地的航班频率远低于主要国内航线的频率。四个星期内出现一次或两次的路线不应被视为可靠的发现机会。
毫不奇怪，在记录的 423 架航班中，有 422 架从戴高乐机场起飞或抵达。例外的是 11 月 6 日往返博洛尼亚 (BLQ) 和威尼斯 (VCE) 的一次性航班。因此，法国枢纽机场仍然是无需预测下一个目的地即可看到飞机的最明显地点，尽管访问的时间有很大差异。
由于每架现役 A318 飞机通常在飞行日完成大约 5 次航班，因此这些飞机全天都会反复出现在戴高乐机场。我们的跟踪数据包含 28 天内从机场出发的 213 趟航班，相当于其余机队平均每天约 8 趟出发。然而，这些活动在一天中的分布并不均匀，有几个时段的活动量比其他时段要多得多。
最有用的早晨窗口是当地时间上午 7:00 至 8:59 之间，记录了 49 架 A318 起飞。另外 44 趟航班发生在中午至下午 1:59 之间，另有 49 趟航班发生在下午 6:00 至晚上 9:59 之间。较晚的航班在冬季不太适合摄影，尽管它们为主要对观看或驾驶飞机感兴趣的人提供了额外的机会。
尤其是在戴高乐机场，值得关注登记，而不是只关注一趟预定的出发航班。从波尔多、马赛或米兰抵达的 A318 可能会在转机后继续前往完全不同的目的地。因此，观察飞机的入境区域可以帮助确定同一机身是否有可能运行下一个航班，而不是等待可能被分配另一种类型的单个航班号。

body_en: James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. James was Market Opportunity Analyst at London Luton Airport and Chief Analyst at anna.aero. He taught airline strategy and economics to undergraduate and postgraduate students for five years and has worked closely with multiple carriers on route and market intelligence projects. He is based near London, UK.

Air Canada is the third-largest international operator in North America. In 2026, Cirium Diio data shows that the Star Alliance member has a total of 96,859 international departures. There are an average of 265 daily departures, varying from as few as 214 to as many as 293.

International flights are down by 19% compared to the record set in 2018. This is driven by the US market, which is at the 18th-lowest level in the past 20 years, partly due to the political situation. However, even long-haul activity is down. The overall picture is less bleak for international seats for sale, as Air Canada is using higher-capacity equipment, with a record of 171 seats per flight.

The Canadian carrier's long-haul network from January 2026 through January 2027 was compared to what is scheduled for February 2027 onwards . This process identified that the following two long-haul routes have been pulled or will end soon. Both have been revealed before, with this article simply summarizing what is happening.

The upcoming cessation of flights to Singapore was probably influenced by the high price of fuel, which necessarily means that the economics of ultra-long-haul routes worsens. Intriguingly, Delta Air Lines looks set to announce a new route from Seattle to Asia next week, which will seemingly be to Singapore . It'll be betting on the price of fuel reducing meaningfully before its first flight lifts off.

Canada's flag carrier flew to Lion City for years until 1991. When service resumed 33 years later in April 2024, flights were nonstop for the first time. Air Canada's return was because of the exit of Singapore Airlines , whose final departure from British Columbia was in September 2023. The Asian carrier's flights were often tagged with those to Seattle, with that route continuing on a nonstop standalone basis today.

Air Canada's exit will come less than three years after the Vancouver route was launched . Covering a considerable 6,923 nautical miles (12,821 km) each way on a great circle basis, the airline runs five times weekly on the 787-9. It is currently the airline's longest nonstop service.

body_en: Aeromexico plans Dreamliner cabin overhaul with private suites and Premium Economy - Aviation24.be

Aeromexico will reconfigure its Boeing 787 fleet between 2029 and 2031, introducing private business class suites and a new Premium Economy cabin. The airline says the project will increase premium seating capacity across its Dreamliner fleet by up to 70%.

Developed with British design firm New Territory, the new interiors will accommodate 259 passengers on the 787-9 and 217 on the 787-8. Aeromexico has not disclosed a complete breakdown of seats by cabin.

The 787-9 will feature Premier One Suites with sliding privacy doors, direct aisle access, fully flat beds and 19-inch 4K screens. A larger Premier One Suites Plus product, developed by Recaro, will offer a 27-inch screen, an oversized dining table and what the airline describes as twice the personal space of its current Premier One seats. Other announced business class features include wireless charging, Bluetooth connectivity and personalised lighting.

Premium Economy will be installed on both Dreamliner variants, offering greater recline, additional legroom and 16-inch 4K screens. The announcement does not specify the future business class configuration of the 787-8.

Both variants will also receive a redesigned Main Cabin, with extra-legroom Elevated AM+ seating in its first three rows. Economy seats will feature 13-inch 4K screens, Bluetooth connectivity and USB charging ports.

The interiors will draw on contemporary Mexican architecture, combining warmer shades of Aeromexico’s blue palette with stone-effect finishes and textiles. The programme also marks ten years of collaboration between the airline and New Territory.

墨西哥航空公司将在 2029 年至 2031 年间重新配置其波音 787 机队，推出私人商务舱套房和全新的豪华经济舱。该航空公司表示，该项目将使其梦想飞机机队的高级座位容量增加多达 70%。
新的内饰由英国设计公司 New Territory 共同开发，787-9 上可容纳 259 名乘客，787-8 上可容纳 217 名乘客。墨西哥航空公司尚未披露按机舱划分的座位的完整详细情况。
787-9 将配备 Premier One 套房，配有滑动隐私门、直接通道、全平床和 19 英寸 4K 屏幕。由 Recaro 开发的一款更大的 Premier One Suites Plus 产品将提供 27 英寸的屏幕、超大餐桌，以及航空公司所说的个人空间是目前 Premier One 座位的两倍。其他宣布的商务舱功能包括无线充电、蓝牙连接和个性化照明。
两种梦想客机都将安装豪华经济舱，提供更大的倾斜度、额外的腿部空间和 16 英寸 4K 屏幕。该公告并未具体说明 787-8 未来的商务舱配置。
两种型号还将配备重新设计的主舱，前三排设有额外腿部空间的加高 AM+ 座椅。经济舱座椅将配备 13 英寸 4K 屏幕、蓝牙连接和 USB 充电端口。
室内设计将借鉴当代墨西哥建筑风格，将墨西哥航空蓝色色调的温暖色调与石材效果饰面和纺织品相结合。该计划还标志着该航空公司与新界之间的十年合作。

body_en: Fire engine mistakenly crosses active runway as Embraer 190 prepares for take-off at Amsterdam Schiphol - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (AMS) Fire engine mistakenly crosses active runway as Embraer 190 prepares for take-off...

A fire engine responding to an emergency call near Amsterdam Schiphol Airport mistakenly drove across an active runway in July, just as an Embraer 190 was preparing for take-off. The incident occurred on 25 July 2026 and is being investigated by the Dutch Safety Board (OVV).

The fire engine, which was not based at Schiphol Airport, was responding to a report of a possible vehicle fire near the A4 motorway, where smoke had been reported in the Schiphol Tunnel. Two fire engines were dispatched, but the planned GPS route directed one of the vehicles across the airport grounds and onto runway 18L, also known as the Aalsmeerbaan.

At approximately 20:45 local time, an Embraer 190 was preparing to depart and had already received take-off clearance from air traffic control. When controllers noticed the fire engine crossing the runway, they immediately cancelled the aircraft’s take-off clearance.
The aircraft received a new take-off clearance once the fire engine had safely crossed the runway and subsequently departed without further incident.

The Dutch Safety Board confirmed that two aviation investigators attended Schiphol on the evening of the incident to conduct an initial investigation into the runway incursion. The investigation remains ongoing.

7 月，当一架 Embraer 190 飞机准备起飞时，一辆消防车在阿姆斯特丹史基浦机场附近响应紧急呼叫，错误地驶过一条正在运行的跑道。该事件发生于 2026 年 7 月 25 日，荷兰安全委员会 (OVV) 正在调查该事件。
这辆消防车并非驻扎在史基浦机场，而是对 A4 高速公路附近可能发生车辆起火的报告做出响应，据报道史基浦隧道内冒烟。两辆消防车出动，但计划的 GPS 路线引导其中一辆车辆穿过机场场地并进入 18L 跑道（也称为 Aalsmeerbaan）。
当地时间20时45分左右，一架巴西航空工业公司190飞机正准备起飞，并已获得空中交通管制的起飞许可。当管制员发现消防车穿越跑道时，他们立即取消了飞机的起飞许可。
消防车安全穿过跑道后，飞机获得了新的起飞许可，随后起飞，没有发生进一步事故。
荷兰安全委员会证实，事件发生当晚，两名航空调查员前往史基浦机场，对跑道入侵事件进行初步调查。调查仍在进行中。

body_en: James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. James was Market Opportunity Analyst at London Luton Airport and Chief Analyst at anna.aero. He taught airline strategy and economics to undergraduate and postgraduate students for five years and has worked closely with multiple carriers on route and market intelligence projects. He is based near London, UK.

It is critically important for an airline to know exactly what it is and isn't. The ultra-low-cost carrier, Allegiant Air , knows the answer immediately. It is and always will be unashamedly a leisure-focused operator, with the acquisition of Sun Country by the Allegiant Travel Company strengthening its position.

If Allegiant's network in Q1 2026 (January to March) is compared to what's available in the same three months in 2027, 26 routes have been removed . Inevitably, some of them involve airports to which the airline no longer flies . Mostly, however, the links have simply been removed from still-served airports.

Schedule analysis using OAG data shows that all of the following markets saw the ULCC in Q1 2026 but will not do so in Q1 2027 . Some may have had flights in January, February, and March this year, while others may have only had service in one or two of the months.

20 of them have been removed entirely from Allegiant's map due to what is normal route churn. No flights are planned beyond the stated month. The remaining six markets are very different. While they won't be served in the first three months of the new year, they'll simply return later in 2027. Some may say that including them is unfair, but they feature because two different time periods were compared.

As Allegiant has pulled out of Columbia, Los Angeles International , Oakland, and Palm Springs, the quartet's last remaining routes in the examined period inevitably featured. Los Angeles International joined the carrier's network in 2009. In the past ten years alone, over 13,000 departures were available . It was the carrier's 18th most-served airport in this period.

While the following links were served by Allegiant in the first three months of 2026, they will not have nonstop operations in the same quarter next year. They are not cut, as they'll all return in spring 2027. Most have simply become seasonal, which is, of course, designed to better align capacity with demand to improve yield and load factor performance.
